title: .explain-change.toml (v1)
description: Shape of the TOML config, for editors and docs. `explain-change check` validates cross-references.

direction.description: The architecture PRs should follow, in one or two sentences.

base.description: Default base ref (else origin/HEAD, main, master or develop, remote first).

budget.description: Digest size in characters (~4 characters per token). --budget overrides it.

layers.description: Diagram lanes, drawn top to bottom in this order (entry points first, core last). Order does not define allowed dependencies: rules do.

allow.description: If present, any other cross-layer edge is a violation. Layer or component ids.

components.description: A file belongs to the component whose matching path is most specific (longest literal prefix); ties go to config order.

paths.description: Path globs: * and ? stay inside one folder, ** crosses folders; a plain dir matches everything below it.

imports.description: TS/Python/require specifiers owned by this component. fnmatch patterns over the whole specifier: * matches any characters, including / and ., so billing.* covers billing.models.invoice.

namespaces.description: C# namespaces. fnmatch patterns: * matches any characters, including ., so Shop.Billing* covers Shop.Billing.Invoices.

constants.description: Ruby constants. fnmatch patterns: * matches any characters, including ::, so Billing::* covers Billing::Stripe::Charge.

flows.description: Reference flows; insight flows with the same id are compared against them.

paths.description: Generated/vendored files: listed apart, never analyzed.
